episodes.synopsis: In a huge departure from their embroidery club, a group of curious girls signs up for an ice hockey class run by the local professional team.
episodes.title: faceoff

episodes.synopsis: The girls get excited when the TV crew comes to film the ryokan. Elsewhere, Riko has to bribe Naomi into playing ice hockey again.
episodes.title: best friends

episodes.synopsis: After learning that Mami is leaving, the girls amp up their training to give her the best possible send-off in the form of a practice match.
episodes.title: all for one

episodes.synopsis: Upon Yoko's request, the girls try out to be official Dream Monkeys. But to pass the test, Manaka and Ayaka must tackle their shortcomings.
episodes.title: grinder

episodes.synopsis: As Yoko plots to lure Yu to the arena, Manaka and the others get fitted for gear and slip into Dream Monkeys uniforms for their first practice as official players.
episodes.title: shoot out

episodes.synopsis: When the new squad plays in a practice game as Dream Monkeys for their first time, Yu is in danger of making the same mistakes as she did on her last team.
episodes.title: debut

episodes.synopsis: While spending the summer in paradise, Kaoruko struggles with communication. To become the pillar her team needs, she'll have to learn how to speak up.
episodes.title: cheer up!

episodes.synopsis: The All-Japan Championships are right around the corner, but Naomi is still too timid to defend. Before the games begin, the TV crew comes back to film again.
episodes.title: accident

episodes.synopsis: With Riko's injury taking her out of the game, the team starts falling apart. To keep their dream alive and continue playing together, Naomi will have to step up her game.
episodes.title: awakening

episodes.synopsis: During Mami's visit to Nikko, the girls hang out and play in the rink. Meanwhile, Eri starts some drama in Snow White over her team's over-reliance on Maya.
episodes.title: reunion

episodes.synopsis: With the final game of the championship coming up, everyone's anxious to play. Yu, in particular, wants to show her former teammates the player she's become.
episodes.title: barn burner

episodes.synopsis: The Dream Monkeys face off against Snow White in the Championship B final. To overcome Maya's dominance, Manaka and the girls will have to work together as a team.
episodes.title: PRIDE OF ORANGE
